items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: George didn't live in here now? ... George is not there, baby. George is speaking English as well.

ctx.x: What about the organ grounders? Do you remember any of the games you used to play when you were kids? I didn't play baseball. A little bit of that. We didn't have time to play baseball. Baseball. Where would you play baseball? I played? Johnson Park? Right there? No, we used to play out in the green. We weren't big enough to play in the park. Park was for what? Professional? Women's. Old men. We were no professional. No? No, didn't Park live. Us. George didn't live in here now? Pardon? Us? Yeah, we've been living…
